# Generated by specializations/tenstorrent_protocol/runtime/emit_cpp.py.
# Two build modes:
#   1. package: find_package(TT-Metalium) against an installed/built tt-metal
#      (pass -DCMAKE_PREFIX_PATH=<prefix>, e.g. /opt/tt/install)
#   2. add_subdirectory: pass -DTT_METAL_SOURCE=<tt-metal checkout>
cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.22...4.2)
project(veritac_tt_protocol CXX)

add_executable(veritac_tt_protocol host_main.cpp)
target_include_directories(veritac_tt_protocol PRIVATE ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR})
target_compile_definitions(veritac_tt_protocol PRIVATE
    VERITAC_KERNEL_DIR="${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/kernels")

if(NOT TARGET TT::Metalium)
    if(TT_METAL_SOURCE)
        add_subdirectory(${TT_METAL_SOURCE} ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/tt-metal EXCLUDE_FROM_ALL)
    else()
        find_package(TT-Metalium REQUIRED)
    endif()
endif()
target_link_libraries(veritac_tt_protocol PUBLIC TT::Metalium)
if(TARGET TT::CommonPCH)
    tt_reuse_precompile_headers(veritac_tt_protocol TT::CommonPCH)
endif()
